verdict.rationale: Keycloak documents an Administration REST API, and its Admin CLI (kcadm.sh) runs the same realm, user, role and client operations over that API. It also documents standard OIDC endpoints (well-known discovery, client registration, introspection, revocation), a SCIM API and an authorization Protection API, so an AI-native user can drive the product programmatically. A hands-on community report says some Admin API GETs return incomplete payloads and some POSTs don't persist, which makes idempotent automation hard; that is a quality caveat, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404) and independent corroboration that the Admin API behaves consistently.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
